title: Calculus Atelier — Course reference notes
provenance: Original project teaching notes, not a quotation from a textbook. Check against the course syllabus before classroom use.

chunks.title: Limits and continuity · 极限与连续
chunks.text: A function is continuous at a when f(a) is defined, the limit as x approaches a exists, and that limit equals f(a). For a removable discontinuity, simplifying an expression can identify the limit but does not redefine the original function at the missing point. A two-sided limit requires the left and right limits to agree. 连续要求函数值与左右极限相等。

chunks.title: Chain rule · 链式法则
chunks.text: For differentiable g at x and f at g(x), the chain rule is $ (f(g(x)))' = f'(g(x))g'(x) $. Identify the inner and outer functions separately. Omitting g'(x) is a possible error, but a single wrong option is insufficient to diagnose a persistent misconception. For a power of a linear function, differentiate the outer power and multiply by the slope of the inner function. 复合函数求导时不能遗漏内函数的导数。

chunks.title: Product rule · 乘积求导
chunks.text: If u and v are differentiable, $ (uv)' = u'v + uv' $. It is generally incorrect to multiply the two derivatives. The quotient rule additionally requires a nonzero denominator. Distinguish addition, multiplication and composition before choosing a differentiation rule. 先识别乘积结构还是复合结构，再选择求导法则。

chunks.title: Stationary points and extrema · 驻点与极值
chunks.text: At an interior differentiable local extremum, the derivative is zero. A zero derivative alone does not imply an extremum. At a stationary point c, f''(c)>0 implies a strict local minimum and f''(c)<0 implies a strict local maximum; f''(c)=0 is inconclusive. On a closed interval, compare endpoint values as well. 驻点不一定是极值点，二阶导数为零时不能直接判定。

chunks.topic: Integration and Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
chunks.title: Fundamental theorem · 微积分基本定理
chunks.text: If f is continuous on [a,b] and F'=f, then $ \int_a^b f(x)\,dx=F(b)-F(a) $. For G(x)=integral from a to x of f(t)dt, G'(x)=f(x) at continuity points. If the upper limit is g(x), the chain rule introduces g'(x). A definite integral is signed accumulation, not automatically geometric area.

chunks.title: Antiderivatives · 原函数与积分常数
chunks.text: An indefinite integral describes a family of antiderivatives. On an interval, antiderivatives of a continuous function differ by a constant. For n not equal to -1, $ \int x^n\,dx=x^{n+1}/(n+1)+C $. The n=-1 case gives log|x|+C on an interval avoiding zero. Differentiate a proposed antiderivative to check it. 不定积分应包含积分常数，并检查定义域。

chunks.title: Substitution · 换元积分
chunks.text: Substitution reverses the chain rule: $ \int f(g(x))g'(x)\,dx=F(g(x))+C $ when F'=f. Write u=g(x) and du=g'(x)dx, and transform the entire integrand consistently. For definite integrals, transform the bounds or return to x before evaluating. Mixing old bounds with the new variable is invalid. 换元后变量、微分和积分上下限必须一致。

chunks.title: Integration by parts · 分部积分
chunks.text: For suitable differentiable functions, $ \int u\,dv=uv-\int v\,du $. This follows from the product rule. Select u and dv so that the remaining integral is simpler, and check the minus sign. For a definite integral, evaluate the boundary term uv at both endpoints. 分部积分需注意负号和边界项。

chunks.title: Area and accumulation · 面积与累积量
chunks.text: The area between curves y=f(x) and y=g(x) is the integral of |f-g| over the interval. Split at intersections when the upper curve changes. For a rate r(t), the integral is net change; total variation requires integrating |r(t)|. Distinguish units of rate from units of accumulation.

chunks.title: Partial derivatives · 偏导数
chunks.text: A partial derivative with respect to x holds the other independent variables fixed. The gradient collects partial derivatives. A directional derivative of a differentiable scalar function is its gradient dotted with a unit direction vector. Differentiability is stronger than mere existence of partial derivatives.

chunks.title: Regions and coordinate changes · 积分区域
chunks.text: An iterated integral must describe the same geometric region as the original problem. When reversing order, redraw the region and derive new bounds rather than swapping symbols. A change of variables includes the absolute value of the Jacobian determinant; polar coordinates contribute the factor r.

chunks.title: Vector fields · 向量场
chunks.text: For a conservative vector field F=grad(phi), a line integral depends only on endpoint potential difference. Vanishing curl is necessary under suitable smoothness, but a converse requires domain assumptions such as simple connectedness. Do not infer path independence without checking the domain.

chunks.title: Series and finite sums · 级数与有限求和
chunks.text: For x not equal to 1, the finite geometric sum from k=0 to N of x^k equals (1-x^(N+1))/(1-x), obtained by multiplying by 1-x and cancelling. For infinite series, a necessary condition for convergence of sum a_n is a_n tending to zero; it is not sufficient. In the ratio test, a limit below one implies absolute convergence, above one divergence, and equal to one is inconclusive. Test power-series endpoints separately.

chunks.title: Parametric curves · 参数曲线
chunks.text: For x=x(t) and y=y(t), dy/dx=(dy/dt)/(dx/dt) where dx/dt is nonzero. A zero denominator requires separate analysis of the parametrization. In polar coordinates x=r cos(theta) and y=r sin(theta); the polar area element contributes the radial factor.

chunks.title: Separable equations · 可分离变量方程
chunks.text: For y'=g(x)h(y), separation divides by h(y) only where h(y) is nonzero. Check equilibrium solutions h(y)=0 separately so they are not lost. An initial condition can determine an integration constant; verify both the equation and the initial condition by substitution.
